summary: A compact, actor-led survival beat with a clear turn from panic to Sayed’s grim reassurance. The dialogue is natural, playable and credible under bombardment; the only notable weakness is that the VO partly describes what the image already shows.
scene_issues: The VO phrase «تَضْرِبُ رِجَالًا فِي حُفَرٍ» repeats the visible action; the documented tank count is the part the scene cannot convey by itself.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Sayed forces the words through the barrage directly into Mostafa’s ear. Make both commands sharp and practical, with no comforting softness.

lines.text: اِلْزَقْ فِي الْحِيطَةْ! وِافْتَحْ بُقَّكْ… عَشَانْ وِدَانَكْ!

performance.delivery: Mostafa spits sand from his mouth and shouts toward Sayed without moving from the wall. The question escapes him before he can make himself sound brave.
Sayed answers Mostafa while still shielding the optic. Punch the first sentence across the noise, then give the second a dry, weighty certainty rather than playing it as a speech.
